lines.say: In 2018, a chicken restaurant ran out of fucking chicken.
K F C had about nine hundred shops in Britain. More than half had to close.
They'd switched delivery companies, and the new setup fell flat on its ass.
People lost their shit. Some of them actually called the police.
The cops had to ask them to stop. Missing chicken isn't a crime.
So K F C bought newspaper ads showing one empty bucket.
They scrambled their own three letters on it. F, C, K.
Under it, they said sorry. A chicken restaurant without any chicken. It's not ideal.
Honest as hell. That apology won a gold advertising award.
